scripts.install:apps: npm install --prefix apps/next && npm install --prefix apps/legacy
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix apps/next && npm run lint:cypress && npm run lint --prefix apps/legacy && npm run lint -w @wfcd/shared
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix --prefix apps/next && npm run lint:fix:cypress && npm run lint:fix --prefix apps/legacy && npm run lint:fix -w @wfcd/shared
scripts.lint:cypress: npm exec --prefix apps/next -- eslint --resolve-plugins-relative-to apps/next -c eslint.cypress.cjs --ignore-path .eslintignore --ignore-pattern '!.releaserc.yaml' cypress cypress.config.ts crowdin.yml .releaserc.yaml
scripts.lint:fix:cypress: npm exec --prefix apps/next -- eslint --resolve-plugins-relative-to apps/next -c eslint.cypress.cjs --ignore-path .eslintignore --ignore-pattern '!.releaserc.yaml' cypress cypress.config.ts crowdin.yml .releaserc.yaml --fix
scripts.test: npm run test:e2e && npm run test:component
